goal: Tie one OpenSpec scenario to one DoD proof leaf, and point /interview, /step-by-step and /cheap-step at that seam.

steps.title: Fork the schema and add a dod artifact
steps.description: Run `openspec schema fork` on the default schema. Add a `dod` artifact to the new `schema.yaml`, output path `dod.md`, `requires: [specs]`.

steps.title: Write the DoD template in the format parser.ts reads
steps.description: Write the `dod` artifact's template into that schema's `templates/` folder, in the format `packages/dod-guard/src/parser.ts` parses.

steps.title: Add dod to applyRequires
steps.description: Add `dod` to `applyRequires` in the forked schema.

steps.title: Write the spec-delta to DoD converter
steps.description: Write the converter. Input: `openspec instructions dod --change <id> --json`. Output: DoD markdown.

steps.title: Map one scenario to one leaf under its requirement
steps.description: Map one scenario to one leaf. Group leaves under their `### Requirement:` heading.

steps.title: Turn an uncheckable scenario into a MANUAL draft leaf
steps.description: Map an uncheckable scenario to a draft leaf with a `MANUAL:` intent, held at INCOMPLETE.

steps.title: Register the generated DoD through dod_import
steps.description: Register the generated file with `dod_import` (`{ path, cwd }`) at `openspec/changes/<id>/dod.md`.

steps.title: Diff at the leaf level so regeneration keeps fingerprints
steps.description: Implement leaf-level diffing on regeneration so an unchanged scenario keeps its leaf's fingerprint intact (see design.md, Decisions). Confirm `dod_amend` can target a leaf subset. Extend it if not.

steps.title: Add the dod-guard trace subcommand
steps.description: Add `dod-guard trace <change-id>` to `packages/dod-guard/src/cli.ts`.
steps.verify_cmd: npm run bundle -w packages/dod-guard && node packages/dod-guard/dist/bundle.js trace adopt-openspec-for-dod-proofs

steps.title: Fail the check on an untraced leaf
steps.description: Implement the leaf-to-scenario direction: an untraced leaf fails the command (non-zero exit).

steps.title: Report an untraced scenario without blocking
steps.description: Implement the scenario-to-leaf direction: an untraced scenario with no `MANUAL:` draft is named in the report without changing the exit code.

steps.title: Make trace a real CI gate and document it
steps.description: Add `dod-guard trace` to the CI gate table in `CLAUDE.md`. The doc may only claim the gate blocks once it actually runs, so trace also needs a disk fallback (CI has no ~/.claude/dod-store) and a step in the plugin-config job.
steps.verify_cmd: grep -q "dod-guard trace" CLAUDE.md && npm run bundle -w packages/dod-guard && node scripts/ci/check-trace.mjs

steps.title: Make steps.json a schema artifact
steps.description: Make `steps.json` a schema artifact with `requires: [dod]`.

steps.title: Convert DoD leaves into steps
steps.description: Write the converter from DoD leaves to steps: proof command becomes `verify_cmd`, intent becomes the step title.

steps.title: Map a MANUAL draft leaf to a manual step
steps.description: Map a `MANUAL:` draft leaf to a step with `manual_required: true`.

steps.title: Carry the requirement into the worker briefing
steps.description: Add the `Requirement` briefing field carrying the scenario's `WHEN` and `THEN` verbatim.

steps.title: State the ASSUMPTION rule in the briefing
steps.description: Add the `ASSUMPTION:` rule to the briefing text.

steps.title: Key staleness off openspec status, not a file mtime
steps.description: Rework the staleness check to key off `openspec status --json` instead of `plan_source` mtime comparison.

steps.title: Name opsx:propose as a plan producer
steps.description: Add OpenSpec (a change proposed through `/opsx:propose`) to the callers list.

steps.title: Commit after each verified step
steps.description: Make the orchestrator commit after each verified step. Update the `step-*` agent definitions to match.

steps.title: Close a session with trace, then archive
steps.description: Extend Finishing: on a green integration check, run `dod-guard trace`, then `openspec archive <id> --yes`.

steps.title: Mirror the step-by-step changes into cheap-step
steps.description: Mirror tasks 5.1 to 5.6 into `/cheap-step`, keeping its `mode` field. cheap-step is written as a delta over step-by-step, so inheritance covers every rule it does not restate. Only the fields cheap-step writes itself need an explicit copy.

steps.title: Hand the spec deltas to the adversarial reviewers
steps.description: Feed the spec delta text to adversarial reviewer agents, not only the code diff.

steps.title: Rewrite interview Phase 4 around an OpenSpec change
steps.description: Rewrite `/interview` Phase 4 to write an OpenSpec change and generate the DoD from it, instead of calling `dod_create` with prose sections.

steps.title: Keep the question floors and the adversarial review
steps.description: Keep the question floors and the adversarial spec review step.

steps.title: Split confirmed answers from unconfirmed ones
steps.description: Move confirmed answers into requirements and scenarios. Move unconfirmed answers into the DoD `open_questions` field.

steps.title: Label questions by risk and cap them at 3 a round
steps.description: Add a Low, Medium or High risk label to each question. Cap clarifying questions at 3 per round.

steps.title: Name opsx:apply in the handoff table
steps.description: Name `/opsx:apply` as an executor option in the handoff table.

steps.title: Stop an ASSUMPTION line tripping todo-marker
steps.description: Resolve the collision with the existing `todo-marker` rule so an `ASSUMPTION:` comment does not trip it.

steps.title: Add the counting assumption-marker rule
steps.description: Add the `assumption-marker` rule: it counts and never fails. Rebaseline `.github/quality/quality-baseline.json` in the same commit.

steps.title: Write the ASSUMPTION convention into the global CLAUDE.md
steps.description: Write the `ASSUMPTION: <what and why>` convention into `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`.

steps.title: Build the assumption audit
steps.description: Build the audit: find every marked guess in source and report it, so a human can give each one a verdict of confirmed and deleted, wrong and fixed, or still open.

steps.title: Decide where the audit runs
steps.description: Decide where the audit runs. Default to a skill, since judging whether a guess still holds needs reading the surrounding code.
